notes: ⚠ A NEW SOURCE PROPERTY WORTH CARRYING TO THE REST OF THE 2014 CYCLE: THIS FILING MIXES TWO FORM VINTAGES INSIDE ONE DOCUMENT. p1 (cover) and p2 (SUMMARY PAGE) are the 2014 blank — cover title '2014 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES', summary subtitle '(NOTE: Complete this page after filling out Schedule A and Schedule B)'. But p3 and p4 are the OLDER (2012-era) schedule sheets: Schedule A's third column is headed 'Mailing Address & Zip Code' rather than the 2014 blank's 'Address, City & Zip', and Schedule B REUSES SCHEDULE A'S HEADINGS ('Name of Contributor' + 'Mailing Address & Zip Code') instead of printing the 2014 blank's 'Purchased From/Source' — which is exactly the 2012 quirk recorded in ADDENDUM B §B4. All three other 2014 filings read in this chunk (Buhman, Lee, Poulson) carry the 2014 headings on their schedules. So the 2014 cycle contains BOTH schedule templates, and a page's column headings must be read from the page, never assumed from the cover's year. This is the schedule-sheet companion to the `utah-template-vintage-year` trap and to Addendum A §A4's Poulson 2010 case. 4 pages: p1 cover, p2 SUMMARY PAGE (located by its printed heading), p3 SCHEDULE A, p4 SCHEDULE B. PAGE-FACE candidate 'GARY RATCLIFFE' (REPUBLICAN, Springville Utah), written in block capitals; office written simply 'SURVEYOR', compatible with and narrower than the channel's 'County Surveyor' — recorded, not adjudicated. index.csv names no candidate, so the page face supplies it. Report type ticked 'Seven days preceding the General Election'; amendment 'No' ticked; signed 10/28/14; the clerk's date-received box is EMPTY on this filing (no stamp), which is an honest blank, not a missed read. FOLIATION: 'Page 1 of 3' / '2 of 3' / '3 of 3' with 'RATCLIFFE' and '10/28/14' on each sheet — cover EXCLUDED, matching Buhman and Poulson and differing from Lee. HANDWRITING: blue ballpoint block capitals for names, cursive elsewhere; cents are consistently RAISED SUPERSCRIPTS over the dollar figure, on the summary page and on both schedules. A STRUCK-AND-CORRECTED ZERO appears in three cells (summary line 1 Column A, summary line 1 Column B, and Schedule A's page subtotal): the filer wrote a slashed zero, then wrote 2038 ¹³ above it and struck the zero through. Handwritten corrections over struck values govern, so 2,038.13 is transcribed and the ladder confirms it. PRIVACY: this filing is NOT redacted — the county published the candidate's own address block and every counterparty address in the clear; the reduction to city/state on contributions and the dropping of addresses on expenditures is mine at read time, per Addendum A §A5. A SELF-FUNDED CAMPAIGN: every dollar in came from the candidate and every dollar went out the same day, so line 3 and line 7 are both written zeros ('-Ø-') and the cycle nets to nothing.
